Step 1: 19 weeks + 7 days = 19 × 7 + 7 = 133 + 7 = 140 days.  
Step 2: 04-08-1383 means 1383-08-04 (YYYY-MM-DD).  
Step 3: Add 140 days: August 4 → +27 days → August 31 (27 days added, 113 left).  
September (30 days) → 83 left, October (31 days) → 52 left, November (30 days) → 22 left, December (31 days) → goes into next year.  
December 31 is end of 1383, 22 days left means January 22, 1384.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1384-01-22
